messages:
Samir: Hey team — quick check: where are the canonical weights for zeta-2.3b? I found two paths and not sure which CI job should pull them. s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/ and hf://redwood/zeta-2.3b-v2
Maria: The S3 path is the one we mirror for production. HF is upstream source-of-truth but not guaranteed stable. Owner is @Maria. perms: redwood-ingest role + read from prod-bucket.
Devon: @Maria can you confirm checksum on S3 matches manifest? CI failed because the manifest sha256 didn't match during last ingest.
Maria: Confirmed — manifest uploaded at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/manifest.json. sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated). I ran: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/weights.pt - | sha256sum```
ingest-bot: manifest v2 uploaded by @Maria at 2141598800 — size 4.2G — tags: model=zeta,version=2.3b
Olivia: Heads up — tokenizer mismatch in v2: HF tokenizer added special tokens; runtime's tokenizer-config.json needs update. If not patched, decoding fails for longer prompts.
Samir: Good catch. @Devon can you add a preflight check in ingest CI to validate tokenizer vocab size + special tokens (compare against tokenizer-config.json)?
Devon: Yep — I'll add a job that runs: ```python tools/validate_tokenizer.py --weights s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/ --tokenizer hf://redwood/zeta-2.3b-v2``` will fail CI if vocab delta > 3 or missing <bos> token.
Maria: Also note we had a manifest field `quantization: int8` — Dedicated infra expects `qconfig: q4_0` now. Need to normalize in registry. I'll update manifest and re-upload.
Samir: Ping for code review on the manifest change: @Devon can you take a look at the PR? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/512 :eyes:
Devon: On it, will review in next 30m.
Olivia: I'll run a smoke serve once manifest is updated — can someone give a presigned URL for weights? CI service account can't access HF.
Maria: Presigned posted in thread: ```https://presigned.s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/weights.pt?X-Amz-...``` expires in 12h.
Devon: Replied on PR, minor nit around qconfig naming. CI job added: `ingest-tokenizer-sanity`. Also added checksum check: command used in job: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta/2.3b/manifest.json - | jq -r .sha256 | xargs -I {} echo "{}"```
Samir: Thanks — after merge Olivia, please run smoke and post logs. If all green we'll flip routing to the new mirror by EOD.
Olivia: Will do. If smoke fails, I'll rollback manifest and ping @Maria.
ingest-bot: smoke-run started by Olivia at 2141598830
